description: List an episode's links in the order listeners see them under its show notes, in its feed and on its page, each with its token, url, title and excerpt. clicks, the number of clicks Fireside has tracked, is included only when click tracking is on and the key belongs to the podcast's owner or a manager. Needs the owner, manager, or producer role.

episode.description: Episode token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_episodes. Slugs default to the episode number but can be customised (e.g. s02e04); check fireside_list_episodes when unsure.

podcast.description: Podcast token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_podcasts. Required unless FIRESIDE_PODCAST is configured.

name: fireside_list_links
title: List links
